workflows.title: Build a Cited Research Brief
workflows.goal: Turn a defined question into a defensible explanation with a reproducible search trail.

steps.title: Literature Reviews
steps.action: Search the question and record inclusion criteria, source dates, and findings.
steps.output: An included-source table with stable identifiers and exclusions.
steps.check: Every included claim has an inspectable source and meets the stated criteria.

steps.title: Qualitative Analysis
steps.action: Code the included-source table for themes and conflicting findings.
steps.output: A theme matrix with source excerpts and alternative explanations.
steps.check: Themes can be traced to source passages; disagreement is retained.

steps.title: Scientific Argumentation
steps.action: Use the theme matrix to write the brief with claim-level support.
steps.output: A cited brief, uncertainty statement, and next evidence question.
steps.check: The conclusion follows from the cited evidence and does not exceed the search scope.

inputs: Scope, date range, and available sources
checks: Every included claim has an inspectable source and meets the stated criteria.
Themes can be traced to source passages; disagreement is retained.
The conclusion follows from the cited evidence and does not exceed the search scope.
workflows.finish: A cited brief, uncertainty statement, and next evidence question. The conclusion follows from the cited evidence and does not exceed the search scope.

workflows.title: Prepare a Research Paper
workflows.goal: Develop the manuscript, figures, and abstract into a consistent submission set.

steps.title: Paper Structure
steps.action: Map the study question, method, and results to the target article structure.
steps.output: A section outline and evidence-to-section map.
steps.check: Every central result has a location and the structure follows the journal requirements.

steps.title: Publication Figures
steps.action: Build figures from the mapped results with units, uncertainty, and captions.
steps.output: Exported figures and a figure-data manifest.
steps.check: Plotted values match the source data and labels remain legible at publication size.

steps.title: Abstract Writing
steps.action: Write the abstract from the final outline and figures.
steps.output: A journal-length abstract with the reported numerical findings.
steps.check: Every abstract result appears in the manuscript and its wording preserves the study limits.

steps.title: Peer Review Checklist
steps.action: Review the complete submission for methodological and reporting gaps.
steps.output: A corrected submission set and resolved review checklist.
steps.check: Methods, results, figures, references, and required declarations agree.

checks: Every central result has a location and the structure follows the journal requirements.
Plotted values match the source data and labels remain legible at publication size.
Every abstract result appears in the manuscript and its wording preserves the study limits.
Methods, results, figures, references, and required declarations agree.
workflows.finish: A corrected submission set and resolved review checklist. Methods, results, figures, references, and required declarations agree.

steps.action: Solve the formulation with a baseline and a documented stopping rule.
steps.output: A reproducible solver configuration and convergence record.
steps.check: The solution meets the stopping rule and respects constraints.

steps.action: Visualize residuals and sensitivity to the important assumptions.
steps.output: A plot set and a short explanation of sensitivity.
steps.check: Residuals and limiting cases support the claimed accuracy.

checks: Dimensions, rank assumptions, and the decomposition match the problem.

steps.output: A concise brand and campaign brief.
steps.check: The brief is specific enough to guide copy and design consistently.

steps.title: Ad Creative
steps.action: Create channel-specific variants from the approved brief.
steps.output: Creative variants with a stated audience and hypothesis.
steps.check: Variants follow channel requirements and differ in a testable way.

steps.title: Campaign Analytics
steps.action: Define measurement and compare observed outcomes against the hypotheses.
steps.output: A campaign measurement plan and evidence-based iteration decision.
steps.check: Tracking and denominators are consistent and results are not attributed beyond the evidence.

checks: The brief is specific enough to guide copy and design consistently.
Variants follow channel requirements and differ in a testable way.
Tracking and denominators are consistent and results are not attributed beyond the evidence.
workflows.finish: A campaign measurement plan and evidence-based iteration decision. Tracking and denominators are consistent and results are not attributed beyond the evidence.

workflows.title: Produce a Captioned Video
workflows.goal: Take a scene plan through editing and a checked final export.

steps.title: Cinematic Shot Prompting
steps.action: Describe shots, camera choices, and continuity from the brief.
steps.output: A shot plan with required assets and scene transitions.
steps.check: Shots serve the narrative and can be produced with the available material.

steps.title: Video Editor
steps.action: Assemble the sequence and refine pacing, sound, and continuity.
steps.output: An edited video and export settings.
steps.check: The sequence preserves meaning and is free of unintended visual or audio discontinuities.

steps.title: Subtitle
steps.action: Add and verify captions against the final cut.
steps.output: A captioned export and subtitle file.
steps.check: Timing, spelling, reading speed, and speaker changes match the audio.

checks: Shots serve the narrative and can be produced with the available material.
The sequence preserves meaning and is free of unintended visual or audio discontinuities.
Timing, spelling, reading speed, and speaker changes match the audio.
workflows.finish: A captioned export and subtitle file. Timing, spelling, reading speed, and speaker changes match the audio.

workflows.title: Prepare Artwork for Print
workflows.goal: Deliver artwork that matches the printer’s actual production requirements.

steps.title: Graphic Designer
steps.action: Develop the composition and asset hierarchy for the physical format.
steps.output: An artwork layout with linked source assets.
steps.check: The message hierarchy works at the intended reading distance.

steps.title: Typography
steps.action: Refine type, spacing, and text flow for the paper and audience.
steps.output: A checked typographic layout.
steps.check: Text remains legible and critical content fits within the agreed safe areas.

steps.title: Print Designer
steps.action: Preflight and export using the printer’s profile, bleed, and proof requirements.
steps.output: A press PDF, production specification, and proof approval.
steps.check: The exported file passes the printer-specific checks and matches the approved proof.

inputs: Printer specification sheet and intended physical format
checks: The message hierarchy works at the intended reading distance.
Text remains legible and critical content fits within the agreed safe areas.
The exported file passes the printer-specific checks and matches the approved proof.
workflows.finish: A press PDF, production specification, and proof approval. The exported file passes the printer-specific checks and matches the approved proof.

workflows.title: Organize a Personal Knowledge System
workflows.goal: Make useful information easy to capture, retrieve, and develop over time.

steps.title: File Organizer
steps.action: Inventory the collection and group files by purpose while preserving originals.
steps.output: A proposed folder map and duplicate review list.
steps.check: Files remain traceable and ambiguous duplicates are not discarded.

steps.title: Para Method
steps.action: Organize active projects, responsibilities, resources, and archives.
steps.output: A working information structure with clear filing rules.
steps.check: A representative item can be filed and retrieved without guessing.

steps.title: Zettelkasten
steps.action: Turn selected useful material into linked notes with source references.
steps.output: A small linked-note set and a repeatable capture routine.
steps.check: Links express meaningful relationships and source context remains available.

inputs: A bounded collection of files and notes
checks: Files remain traceable and ambiguous duplicates are not discarded.
A representative item can be filed and retrieved without guessing.
Links express meaningful relationships and source context remains available.
workflows.finish: A small linked-note set and a repeatable capture routine. Links express meaningful relationships and source context remains available.

workflows.title: Reconcile and Review a Business Period
workflows.goal: Connect reconciled accounts to a clear operational financial review.

steps.title: Month End Close
steps.action: Reconcile the period and classify timing items and required corrections.
steps.output: A reconciliation with explained differences and sign-off items.
steps.check: Opening balance, movements, and closing balance reconcile to the source records.

steps.title: Financial Analyst
steps.action: Analyze the reconciled statements and explain material movements.
steps.output: A financial review with calculation inputs and assumptions.
steps.check: Ratios and comparisons use consistent periods and reconciled figures.

steps.title: Saas Metrics Coach
steps.action: Connect the financial review to the applicable operating metrics.
steps.output: A metric review with definitions and the next management questions.
steps.check: Metric definitions, cohorts, and denominators are explicit and consistent.

inputs: General ledger and bank statement exports
Reporting period, policies, and operating metrics
checks: Opening balance, movements, and closing balance reconcile to the source records.
Ratios and comparisons use consistent periods and reconciled figures.
Metric definitions, cohorts, and denominators are explicit and consistent.
workflows.finish: A metric review with definitions and the next management questions. Metric definitions, cohorts, and denominators are explicit and consistent.

workflows.title: Build a Customer Support System
workflows.goal: Turn recurring support work into a usable service process and knowledge base.

steps.title: Customer Success Manager
steps.action: Identify customer needs, recurring friction, and escalation expectations.
steps.output: A customer outcome and escalation map.
steps.check: The map reflects actual support evidence and service commitments.

steps.title: Support Ops
steps.action: Design routing, coverage, and response measures for the mapped needs.
steps.output: A support operating plan with ownership and thresholds.
steps.check: Coverage fits capacity and escalation rules handle urgent or uncertain cases.

steps.title: Knowledge Ops
steps.action: Turn resolved cases into searchable, maintained support procedures.
steps.output: A knowledge base with owners, review dates, and feedback paths.
steps.check: A new team member can find and follow a representative procedure.

checks: The map reflects actual support evidence and service commitments.
Coverage fits capacity and escalation rules handle urgent or uncertain cases.
A new team member can find and follow a representative procedure.
workflows.finish: A knowledge base with owners, review dates, and feedback paths. A new team member can find and follow a representative procedure.

workflows.title: Collect Structured Data from the Web
workflows.goal: Extract a bounded set of web records and turn it into a checked dataset.

steps.title: Browser Automation
steps.action: Inspect the actual pages and extract the required fields with source URLs and collection times.
steps.output: A structured record set with source locations and extraction errors.
steps.check: The extract covers the intended records and retains enough evidence to inspect any value.

steps.title: Data Quality Auditor
steps.action: Check types, completeness, duplicate records, and field consistency in the extract.
steps.output: A quality report and corrected dataset.
steps.check: Invalid records are reported explicitly and corrections can be traced to the source.

steps.title: SQL Database Assistant
steps.action: Load the checked dataset into the chosen schema and answer the original query.
steps.output: A reproducible import and query result.
steps.check: Imported counts and query totals reconcile with the checked dataset.

inputs: Target pages and fields to collect
Authorized browsing context and expected record structure
checks: The extract covers the intended records and retains enough evidence to inspect any value.
Invalid records are reported explicitly and corrections can be traced to the source.
Imported counts and query totals reconcile with the checked dataset.
workflows.finish: A reproducible import and query result. Imported counts and query totals reconcile with the checked dataset.
